name: EXIR 36x Bullet Explosion-proof Network Camera Hikvision DS-2DB4236I-CWX
summary: Explosion-proof design: the camera has passed international ATEX & IECEx certifications, and can be used in gas and dust hazardous scenarios protecting the camera from damage caused by sparks or corrosive materials PTZ: pan-tilt-zoom ability allows the camera to move to view zones of interest Up to 36X zoom: zoom to examine subjects of interest within expansive scenes IP68 water resistant, preventing water ingress for outdoor use A built-in heater allows for start-up in ultra-low temperatures to -40℃
